messages:
marta (PM): Quick sync  ACME pilot target 2026-04-01. Need to lock minimal launch scope: runtime KV change, tenant CMK, and staging prewarm. Callouts only pls (who owns + yes/no on CMK canary).

alex (Eng): I can drive runtime KV change. Canary without CMK = acceptable if fallback documented. Need a short acceptance checklist from product.

sam (Runtime): Canary sans-CMK ok with strong isolation + audit. FYI KV tweak may add ~8ms p95; I'll bench in staging.

jess (Infra): Prewarm options: burstable hosted (fast, quota ~3d) or Reserved Dedicated (1wk+). Recommend burstable to meet date.

casey (SRE): If burstable, put alert: sustained_utilization >70% for 2h -> conversion runbook. I can own that. Also note maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC.

li (Security): CMK onboarding requires HSM + rotation policy review; earliest review slot I have is 2026-03-18. If canary runs without CMK, provide data-separation doc + ENC-in-transit proof and a mitigation list.

alex (Eng): Draft acceptance checklist: 1) E2E on ACME test tenant with prefix cache; 2) simulated KMS failure validated; 3) staging p95 <120ms; 4) feature flag + rollback path.

marta (PM): Add: 5) security sign-off (li); 6) infra prewarm applied (jess). Action owners/due: alex (delivery plan + rollback) Thu COB; sam (perf matrix) Fri EOD; jess (open quota ticket) today; li (design doc) Thu noon; casey (runbook) today. Reply "ack" on your line to accept.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack  will post perf table to /perf/results

jess (Infra): ack  opening INFRA ticket now

casey (SRE): ack  will include maintenance window in runbook

li (Security): ack  will slot review once doc is in

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary deploys blocked then :no_entry_sign:

marta (PM): Thanks all, I'll stitch into a one-page launch checklist after Thu updates.
